sources.readScope: Complete selected index; model source-priority rules
sources.observation: The model-specific Console documentation takes precedence over the supplementary OpenAPI catalog. Absence from OpenAPI does not prove unavailability. Production and preview must stay explicit; authenticated access has not been checked.

Current official docs support a persisted visible-ASCII Idempotency-Key, unchanged endpoint/body/webhook replay and original request identity across terminal states. A changed request returns422; never automatically create a new key. A replay receipt can show queued even if finished, so status must be queried. This supersedes the unofficial no-idempotency claim encountered in search. Local controller intentionally remains conservative and does not perform replays.

Requests expose queued/in_progress/completed/failed/nsfw/canceled. Persist request_id and use returned status/cancel addresses; only queued work can cancel. Remote completed URLs still require acquisition, byte identity and admission before native SUCCEEDED.

Authentication/validation/account errors differ from transient server/read errors.422 also covers idempotency mismatch. Correlation IDs help support; human-readable messages are not permanent business predicates. Refund documentation is a policy observation, not measured settlement.

Selected guidance begins around2 seconds, caps near10 seconds and adds jitter.401/404 stop for credential/identity review; network/5xx status reads may retry. The native polling implementation adds an absolute deadline including request and sleep time.

Webhook output nests inside payload. Durably record before2xx, valid duplicates remain acknowledged, network/5xx retries last up to2 hours,4xx stops. This selected page does not document a cryptographic delivery signature, so callbacks are hints until independently authenticated/reconciled; no guessed signing contract is implemented.

Authenticated estimates return decimal-string credits/USD; examples are not quotes. Success consumes credits; failed/nsfw and successful queued cancellation are documented as refunded. Credits expire after a year; generated URLs last at least7 days. Preserve exact fractional-cent estimates, separately ceil an authorization cap and reconcile actual charges.

sources.readScope: Endpoint, auth, model/content, media limits, ratio, expansion and callback sections
sources.observation: H3 and H3-Max have different resolutions/durations. First/last conditioning cannot mix with reference roles. I2V uses input-image aspect rather than an exact requested ratio. JSON Bearer-auth V2 submission returns task_id; callbacks use a challenge plus state updates. Documented behavior is not verified account access.

sources.readScope: Purpose, endpoint, content constraints, task type and enhanced prompt result
sources.observation: H3-Context-IR creates an asynchronous prompt-enrichment task, not video. Successful h3_context_ir tasks yield content.prompt. The implementation is expressly not open source. Semantic review and a separately approved generation request remain necessary; the API is not a native replica of the proprietary reasoning system.

sources.readScope: GET endpoint, task envelope, example output/usage and7-day lookup scope
sources.observation: GET /v2/query/video_generation/{task_id} returns task.id/status/type/content/usage for recent tasks. Prompt and video tasks share lookup but different result semantics. The7-day scope makes durable native receipts and asset retention necessary.

sources.readScope: Endpoint and cancel-versus-delete purpose; full lower schema not claimed
sources.observation: DELETE may cancel a queued task or delete a succeeded/failed record according to remote state. Therefore a generic cancel button must reconcile first; terminal-record deletion cannot be treated as harmless cancellation. No delete request has been executed.

sources.readScope: Connection, OAuth, workflow/library, model and credit sections
sources.observation: YouArt documents Streamable HTTP at mcp.youart.ai/mcp with host-managed OAuth; website login alone is insufficient. Advertised capabilities include project/canvas workflows, upload, reuse and image/video/audio/text. MCP generations consume existing account credits. Public descriptions do not reveal live tools/list schemas or implementation internals.
